behavioral_target.source_quotes: exact contiguous participant answer text only

primary_endpoint.name: predicted_top_set_mean_behavioral_midrank
primary_endpoint.definition: Mean tie-aware behavioral midrank of every body tied for the highest CF-003 predictor score. With a unique predictor top, this is that predicted body's behavioral rank.

secondary_endpoints: tie-aware Spearman correlation between the two complete 10-body rank vectors

null.rule: Apply the same permutation of the ten evaluator labels to every participant behavioral profile; preserve each participant profile and construct marginals; recompute the complete target statistic.

development_policy.prospective_activation: freeze this manifest, classifier prompt/contract, mapping, questions, software commit, tie rules, permutation seed/count and chart predictor before opening new target responses

chart_predictor_status.input_required: seven precomputed binary factor flags for each of ten candidate bodies
chart_predictor_status.prospective_requirement: obtain exact historical conventions or freeze/label a transparent new CF-003 factor reimplementation before opening target responses

classifier_model_status: development model/version not prospectively frozen yet
source_coverage_rule: Three-question supplement assumes usable source for the nine inherited domains; any remaining insufficient construct makes the ten-way target incomplete until separately frozen follow-up source is collected.
